integrity: Mathematical proof and finite standalone checks provided; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unital coefficient-fixing maps only; fixed characteristic and field size in the limit. The p=2,d=2 characteristic-two exterior-algebra count was already known; novelty concerns the general formula and logarithmic-codimension concentration. Earlier exact retract counts may exist in less accessible finite-local-algebra sources.
title: Coordinate conjugacy, exact retraction counts and logarithmic codimension in modular elementary-abelian group algebras
